```{python}
q1 = """
SELECT
    p.playerID,
    p.nameFirst AS first_name,
    p.nameLast AS last_name,
    MAX(b.yearID) - MIN(b.yearID) + 1 AS career_length
FROM People p
JOIN Batting b
    ON p.playerID = b.playerID
GROUP BY
    p.playerID,
    p.nameFirst,
    p.nameLast
ORDER BY career_length DESC
LIMIT 10
"""

career_df = pl.read_database(q1, con)

career_df
```

```{python}
q2 = """
SELECT
    s.playerID,
    f.POS AS position,
    s.salary
FROM Salaries s
JOIN Fielding f
    ON s.playerID = f.playerID
    AND s.yearID = f.yearID
WHERE f.POS IS NOT NULL
"""

salary_df = pl.read_database(q2, con)

salary_summary = (
    salary_df
    .unique(subset=["playerID", "position", "salary"])
    .group_by("position")
    .agg([
        pl.col("salary").mean().alias("average_salary"),
        pl.col("playerID").n_unique().alias("total_players"),
        pl.col("salary").max().alias("highest_salary")
    ])
    .with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("average_salary") > 3000000)
        .then(pl.lit("High Salary"))
        .when(pl.col("average_salary") >= 2000000)
        .then(pl.lit("Medium Salary"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("Low Salary"))
        .alias("salary_category")
    )
    .sort("average_salary", descending=True)
)

salary_summary
```
